description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 ATK to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Water Ability Boost, Triplecast Water, Unlimited Water Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Water Abilities, Water Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Water Abilities; Ends after using 8 Water abilities
TP Max: AOE Water/NE ranged physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text:
Single-target Water/NE piercing ranged physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Water Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold to all targets with at least 0/40% Imperil Water
WS Blue: Imperil Water 30% to all enemies
WS Gold: DeProtect 20% to all enemies
